Package com.egradx.notification.channel.sms

Class EgradxSmsChannel

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.channel.EgradxProviderBackedChannel<EgradxSmsProvider>
com.egradx.notification.channel.sms.EgradxSmsChannel
All Implemented Interfaces:
EgradxNotificationChannel
public class EgradxSmsChannel extends EgradxProviderBackedChannel<EgradxSmsProvider>
SMS, through whichever EgradxSmsProvider the organization's configuration names. To turn it on for an organization: 

 PUT /egradx/notifications/admin/channels/sms
 {"enabled": true,
  "settings": {"provider": "twilio", "accountSid": "AC…", "from": "+14155552671"},
  "secret": "<Twilio auth token>"}

Text only, at most 1600 characters — refused at submit time above that rather than split or truncated by a gateway. A subject, if the message has one, becomes the first line.

Some countries regulate business SMS further — India's DLT registration, for one, requires a registered template id per message. That is a gateway's concern, handled by a provider for that gateway.
